title: Owner Decision Custody Receipt
description: Records Owner decisions (approve/deny) on write-custody enforcement. Preserves the decision custody chain for audit and governance review. Advisory-only — does not approve, seal, or mutate.

receipt_id.description: Unique receipt identifier. Generated deterministically from request content.

custody_source.description: Whether this receipt was generated from a live enforcement, a write-custody check, or a dry-run.

source_contract.description: Reference to the sealed contract that authorized the enforcement (e.g. '#23').

decision_type.description: The Owner's decision on the write request.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this receipt was generated.

deterministic.description: Whether this receipt was generated deterministically from the request content.

immutable.description: Whether this receipt is immutable after generation.

project_id.description: The project that requested the write.

sprint_id.description: The sprint that requested the write.

file_path.description: The file path that was requested to be written.

transition.description: The lifecycle transition requested, if any.

reason.description: The reason for the write request.

request.description: The original write request that was evaluated.

blocker_code.description: The blocker code if the write was denied, empty string if allowed.

violation_code.description: The violation code if the write violated a rule, empty string if allowed.

triggered_rules.description: List of enforcement rules that were triggered during evaluation.

owner_approval_present.description: Whether explicit Owner approval was present for this write.

owner_approval_ref.description: Reference to the Owner approval, if present.

approval_is_broad.description: Whether the approval was broad (covering multiple writes) or specific.

provenance.description: Provenance information about the Owner's approval.

mutation_status.description: Whether the write was actually executed, blocked, or dry-run.

sprint_id.description: The sprint this receipt is linked to.

ledger_numbers.description: Ledger numbers this receipt is linked to.

source_receipt_id.description: Source receipt ID if this receipt was derived from another.

linked_references.description: Links to related sprint and ledger entries.

sealed_contracts_referenced.description: List of sealed contract numbers referenced by this receipt.
